subject: Veridian - Identity onboarding playbook & SCIM/SAML clarifications
messages:
From: Alyssa Monroe <alyssa@veridianinc.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@veridianinc.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:09:00 -0800
Subject: Identity onboarding playbook and SCIM/SAML questions

Hi Marcus / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick demo last week — Veridian’s IS team had a few follow-ups as we prepare a procurement package. We need two things to move forward: a concise onboarding playbook for our engineering and IdM teams, and a completed SCIM/SAML/RBAC questionnaire so we can accelerate our procurement review. Specifically: 

- SCIM: attribute mapping template (we provision users from Okta). Do you support PATCH, bulk imports, and custom attribute mapping?
- SAML/OIDC: NameID formats supported, assertion lifetime, and recommended claim mappings for groups/roles.
- RBAC/admin controls: recommended role hierarchy, delegated admin options (tenant-admin, read-only admin), session timeout/default MFA enforcement.
- Evidence: a short admin-role matrix and any sample provisioning logs or event types we can present to security.

Can you share the playbook + a completed template by next Tuesday (2026-11-30)? We may also want a short workshop to walk our IdM team through SCIM attribute mapping.

Thanks,
Alyssa Monroe
Sr. IT Security Manager, Veridian Inc.
alyssa@veridianinc.com

Attachments: (none)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Monroe <alyssa@veridianinc.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Identity onboarding playbook and SCIM/SAML questions

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the clear list. We can definitely meet the timeline. High level answers up front:

- SCIM: we support PATCH (RFC 7644), bulk import via CSV + SCIM bulk endpoints, custom attribute mappings, and SCIM delta syncs for incremental provisioning.
- SAML/OIDC: SAML NameID formats supported: persistent and transient; OIDC: we support standard subject sub + configurable preferred_username and email claims. Assertion/lifetime defaults are 5 minutes for SAML assertions and access token lifetime 1 hour (both configurable).
- RBAC: recommended starter roles: account-admin, tenant-admin (delegated), app-admin, read-only-monitor. We also support scoped roles for resource-level RBAC.

I’m attaching a short draft playbook and a first-pass admin matrix for your review. Marissa — can you review the RBAC rows (delegated admin flows, session controls) and update the matrix where needed? Karthik — can you confirm SCIM rate-limit guidance for large customer orgs and whether we should call out delta sync interval recommendations?

Proposed next step: 30–45 minute workshop — available slots next week — I’ll include a Calendly link below.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0168

Marcus / Karthik — quick internal notes before we send final: 

On Fri, Nov 26, 2026 at 9:17 AM Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com> wrote:
> I’m attaching a short draft playbook and a first-pass admin matrix for your review.

I updated the admin matrix (attached) with:
- explicit delegated role: tenant-admin (can create/manage teams, invite users, view usage)
- session control recommendations: idle timeout 30 min default for web console, max session 12 hours; optional device-bound session tokens for elevated ops calls
- provisioning attributes: added scim:externalId, preferredLanguage, manager, costCenter, and two custom metadata slots for customer usage tags
- SCIM behavior: PATCH, BULK, and incremental delta supported; we added recommended polling interval guidance (delta every 60s for high-change directories, otherwise 15 min)

Karthik: rate limiting notes — for orgs >50k users we recommend a staged bulk import with throttled concurrency (we set default ingestion at 20 users/sec; can increase with dedicated capacity). Please confirm the 20 users/sec guidance and whether we want to include an example curl for PATCH.

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Identity onboarding playbook and SCIM/SAML questions

Hi Alyssa / Tom — following up with the deliverables and a few concrete answers below. We’ve attached the playbook, SCIM template, and an updated admin matrix (v2) for your security packet.

Summary answers (short):
- SCIM: supports RFC7644 PATCH, bulk, and incremental delta. We provide a CSV import for initial seeding and a bulk SCIM endpoint for programmatic imports. Recommended ingest guidance: start at 20 users/sec for staged imports for orgs >50k and increase to 50–100 users/sec only after testing on a staging tenant.
- SAML/OIDC: NameID supported formats: persistent (transient available). Assertion lifetime default: 5 minutes; recommended audience restriction on the assertion. OIDC: we emit sub, email, email_verified, name, preferred_username; groups are available as a claim when requested.
- RBAC/Admin controls: we recommend three operational tiers by default — account-admin (billing & global config), tenant-admin (delegated tenant ops), app-admin (application-level configuration), plus read-only-monitor. Tenant-admin can be scoped to projects and can be configured to require MFA for elevation.
- Evidence & logs: we include provisioning event logs (create/update/delete), SAML login events (assertion timestamps, issuer, subject), and admin-action audit trails (who changed roles, time, IP). We can provide redacted sample logs for your security review.

Attachments included (zipped in email):
- redwood_identity_playbook_v1.pdf — onboarding steps, recommended timelines, and rollback instructions
- veridian_scim_template.csv — SCIM attribute mapping template (Okta export friendly)
- redwood_admin_matrix_v2.xlsx — role definitions, privileges, and session defaults

Next steps:
1) Please confirm if the SCIM attribute list in veridian_scim_template.csv aligns with your Okta export.
2) If helpful, we can run a 45-minute onboarding workshop — provisional slots via Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/identity-onboarding-workshop
3) We can provide a short sample of provisioning logs (redacted) after an NDA/PO is in place.

If you’d like, we can also include a short appendix with sample SCIM PATCH curl commands and a recommended rate-limit testing plan.

Best,
Marcus Lin
